verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Solid can be used as a small embedded UI (Asciinema case study), supports authoring reusable web components/custom elements, offers direct DOM access for interop with existing code, and scales up to full SSR/serverless apps with SolidStart, which together support incremental adoption from a widget to a full app. However there's no explicit first-party guide on mounting Solid into an existing non-Solid page or a documented migration path, and community notes ecosystem gaps (e.g., Framer Motion, tRPC adapters) that could complicate partial integration. Missing for 10: an explicit 'add Solid to existing site' tutorial/guide, and independent case studies of large legacy apps incrementally migrating to Solid.
